Bonus action: Insight or Investigation against a creature's Charisma save DC; success: whether its Str, Dex or Con is highest and its Wis, Int or Cha lowest.
On your turn: swap places with a willing creature in initiative; at the end of the later turn your initiative positions swap.

rules.text: One role after each rest: Infiltrator (move through larger or same-size enemies' spaces; unheard and undetected by traps and alarms while moving), Field Analyst or Tactical Swap.

activities.label: Seize: add to a contested check

roll.note: Add the Superiority Die to your contested check.
Bonus action, when a maneuver, item or feature you use forces a save: the creature can't gain save bonuses from jutsu it casts.

activities.label: Shadow Drain
activities.text: Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized (only the subclass that lists it can take it). Reaction: a creature within 30 feet gains a bonus to hit or damage. Failure: it loses the bonus and you gain it until the end of your next turn.

roll.note: Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized (only the subclass that lists it can take it). Reaction: a creature within 30 feet hits an ally (not you). Reduce the attack roll by the die.

Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized (only the subclass that lists it can take it). Bonus action: your Flux ends and a creature within 30 feet gains its benefits until the start of your next turn; you can spend dice on maneuvers for them.

Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized (only the subclass that lists it can take it). On a hit or failed save: a Squad-Mate makes the save against a jutsu effect on you with its statistics; on a success the effect ends.

rules.text: One known jutsu of B-Rank or lower (switch after a Full Rest) gets a Signature Modification and counts as your Primary; a second modification at 15th. The modifications are notes on their features.

Your Signature Jutsu ignores resistance and treats immunity as resistance. Warfare: add the jutsu's ability modifier to its damage. Seize: cast it as a Bonus action instead of an Action (not both in a turn).

Upcast: +1 damage or healing die. Seize: a creature reacting with a jutsu to you pays your level more for it. Tactics: an attack jutsu can include a skill-based action that takes an Action or Bonus action.
It costs its rank less (D 1, C 2, B 3, A 4, S 5). Tactics: +1d4 to checks it calls for. Warfare: two maneuvers per turn, both on its casting.
At 9th, your first Shinobi Path's enhanced benefit (the Path features); at 18th, your second path's.

roll.note: Damaging a hostile creature with your Primary casting discipline: apply both Follow Up and Set-Up to it.

rules.text: Once per casting, after damage: switch your Fighting Stance and your Generalization.

Up to 6 Bunshin. A Clone Ninjutsu with a nature release gives your Bunshin that bonus (up to two keywords at once): Earth (10 HP, 10 DR, 10 temporary hit points again each turn), Fire (6d6 fire, Dex save, 10 feet when dropped to 0), Water (no damage on a passed save; your Ninjutsu attack bonus for saves), Lightning (d8s instead of d6s).

roll.note: Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized (only the subclass that lists it can take it). Under a lasting condition, jutsu or trait: another save or check against it, adding the die (no DC: 10 + its level or rank value; D 5, C 7, B 9, A 11, S 13).

activities.label: Spirit Siphon
activities.text: Dealing chakra damage. Failure: 1 rank of Slowed. With a Mental condition, it saves at disadvantage.

roll.note: Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized (only the subclass that lists it can take it). Failing a save that deals damage and inflicts a condition: add the die; if you now succeed, hostile creatures within 20 feet make a Wisdom save or are Dazed until the start of your next turn.

activities.label: Staggering Will: Wisdom save
activities.text: When Staggering Will turned the save (die already spent).

roll.note: Using a maneuver: your barrier regains the highest die rolled for it (no dice: roll a Superiority Die). Enter it.

activities.label: Superego Manifestation
activities.text: Bonus action, up to 1 minute (ends if you're unconscious): fused with your Void Soul; cast its jutsu; advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saves and checks; allies within 10 feet +2 to attack and damage.

rules.text: Two Arbitration maneuvers (more by the class table). Proficiency in Deception, Intimidation and Persuasion (a rank of Mastery if already proficient).
Two Assault maneuvers (more by the class table). +1 critical range with attacks of your Primary casting discipline (+2 from 10th, Remarkable Aggression) is on its effect.

Two Cloning maneuvers. Shadow Clone Technique as a Bonus action; summon Bunshins in place of its clones with the Bunshin button (once per Bunshin; the Class & Clan Summons NPC, its AC, attacks, DCs, skills and senses from you). Up to 4 (6 at 10th, 8 at 17th); 1 minute in combat or 1 hour outside; up to 1 mile; dispelled if they enter combat another way. Commands: Where I say, Clone Strike, Split Focus.
Four Barrier maneuvers (more by the class table).

roll.note: On a hit: Disarm, Trip and Shove using the attack result against its AC.

rules.text: Two Elemental maneuvers. Choose a nature release (you can learn its jutsu). Elemental Infusion (Strike): after a nature release jutsu, your unarmed and weapon attacks deal its damage type until the end of your next turn. Once per turn, a jutsu without a nature release can take yours.

roll.note: On a hit: Demoralize and Feint using the attack result against its Wisdom save DC.

rules.text: Four Trickster maneuvers. The Void Soul stat block is the Void Soul NPC in Class & Clan Summons (Void Heart Mask's button places it).

roll.note: Once per turn: one more action, only to cast a jutsu of a different discipline than one you cast this turn (and no more of that discipline with your action). Each use before a rest costs +1 die (Relentless: 2 actions for +2; The Elite: −1).

rules.text: Four Pathfinder maneuvers (more by the class table).

roll.note: In place of an attack of the Attack action or as a Bonus action (a skill-based action): Deception against the AC of a creature within 20 feet. Success: teleport to a space within 10 feet of it, and apply Follow Up to it.

rules.text: Two Phantom maneuvers. Proficiency in Deception and Illusions (a rank of Mastery if already proficient).

roll.note: Reaction: a creature misses you. A melee or ranged weapon attack; on a hit, 1 rank of Weakened, Demoralized or Shaken (your pick).
At the start of each of your turns.

rules.text: All jutsu you cast of C-Rank and lower count as your Signature Jutsu.
Allies benefiting from your Projected or Rallying Barrier are Shielded until the end of your next turn: one Projected Barrier ability without a Superiority Die, then it ends.

roll.note: Bonus action: cast a 1-Action jutsu that teleports you or raises your speed as a Bonus action.

rules.text: Concentrate on up to 3 jutsu that teleport you or raise your speed.

roll.note: A creature saves against your jutsu's effect: it rerolls and takes the lower; on a failure, 1 rank of Demoralized, Shaken or Sealed (your pick).
Once per turn, when an ally attacks or casts a jutsu: they apply the effects of a maneuver you know.

rules.text: Two Tactical maneuvers (more by the class table), and one more Shinobi Path.
The Superiority Dice pool (d8; 3 at 2nd, by the class table) is on the class; all of it back after 10 minutes of rest or meditation.

roll.note: At the start of another creature's turn: you each roll 1d20 + half your current speed. Higher: it is Slowed, and you cast one of your Mobile Savant jutsu free.

Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized (only the subclass that lists it can take it). In Flash: swap with a creature in teleport range. Willing ally: + the die to its AC against the next attack. Unwilling: a Charisma save; failure swaps, and −2 AC until the end of its next turn.

activities.label: Swap Spots: unwilling
activities.text: The unwilling creature's save (die already spent).

activities.label: Follow Up
activities.text: One affected creature, until the end of your next turn: +1 to hit it (+2 at 11th, +3 at 19th) with your next jutsu that isn't your Primary.

activities.label: Set-Up (AC)
activities.text: All affected creatures: −AC against the next jutsu one of your allies (not you) casts before the start of your next turn.

activities.label: Set-Up (saves)
activities.text: All affected creatures: −saves against the next jutsu one of your allies (not you) casts before the start of your next turn.

rules.text: Your Primary casting discipline is the level-up choice. Follow Up's +1 to hit is automatic for non-Primary jutsu attacks against the marked creature; its save DC option is at the table. End Follow Up and Set-Up after the next jutsu.

roll.note: Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized (only the subclass that lists it can take it). In Flash, teleporting: a willing ally within 10 feet teleports instead.

activities.label: Tactical Breakthrough
activities.text: Damage that DR or temporary hit points would reduce. Failure: they lose twice the die of DR or temporary hit points until the end of the turn.

roll.note: Reaction: a hostile creature takes an Action. Disengage and Dash, move your full speed; add the die to Athletics or Acrobatics checks this turn.
Attacking a creature that gains AC from a reaction: it makes a Chakra Control check against your DC or loses the bonus this turn.
Your reaction jutsu that reduces damage: add twice the die to it.
The Attack action: forgo an attack to cast a C-Rank or lower jutsu making no more than one attack, then finish the attacks. Each further use this turn costs +1 die.
Add this to the skill-based action's check.

rules.text: A skill-based action that takes an Action can be a Bonus action; once per turn, one that takes a reaction costs no action.

roll.note: Bonus action: 1 Bunshin (2 at 10th, 3 at 17th). Then place them with the Bunshin button (once per Bunshin).
Summoning 2 or more clones or Bunshin at once with a Clone Ninjutsu.

rules.text: Your Bunshin use your Cloning maneuvers, Switch Hitter and Jack of All with your limits.

activities.label: Team Guard
activities.text: Within 10 feet of an ally: allies within 10 feet, you included, get +2 AC and saves, and reduce damage taken by the die, until the start of your next turn while within 10 feet. Target them.

roll.note: Casting two jutsu of different disciplines in a turn, or attacking with a weapon or unarmed and casting your Primary in a turn.

rules.text: Superior Momentum costs 1 die less (pay one less). Two more maneuvers per turn.

activities.label: Transverse Defense
activities.text: Reaction to damage from an attack or jutsu: resistance to its damage this turn (end it after that damage).

activities.label: Ultimate: Revolution
activities.text: Bonus action: willing creatures within 60 feet get +4 critical range, and vulnerability to the next damage they take before the end of your next turn (at the table). Target them.

rules.text: Your Squad is also immune to Confused while you aren't incapacitated (give them the effect at the table). Starting a turn within 10 feet of another Squad-Mate: 10 temporary hit points until the start of the next turn, and advantage on saves against forced movement or teleport while they last.
In Flash: immune to speed reductions from conditions. Athletics and Acrobatics checks to traverse terrain at advantage; standing from Prone costs no movement.

activities.label: Warfare bonus (free)
activities.text: Once per turn: your Warfare bonus damage without a Superiority Die (half the dice for an area or an unarmed or weapon attack).

rules.text: Maneuvers that roll the die: roll it twice, take the higher (reroll at the table).

Bonus action: the Void Soul button places it (the Class & Clan Summons NPC; its level, hit point maximum, speed and save proficiencies come from you). Set its ability scores to your +4, +3, +2, +2, +1, +0 and add its jutsu (as many as your proficiency bonus). Command it with your Bonus Actions; damage to it is lost from your hit points. Dismiss it as a bonus action or when you fall unconscious (it also lapses after a day).

activities.label: Warfare: attack bonus
activities.text: Once per turn, casting a jutsu or making an unarmed or weapon attack. Area jutsu, and unarmed or weapon attacks: half the dice, rounded up (minimum 1). With a Scouting Technique maneuver: one die fewer.

rules.text: Multiattack with a Kunai, Shuriken or Senbon adds your ability modifier to the damage.
While in Warfare: add your ability modifier to Multiattack damage with a Kunai, Shuriken or Senbon.

roll.note: Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized (only the subclass that lists it can take it). Damaging your Combat Rival with an attack: that many creatures within 10 feet of it; if your attack hits their AC, they take half the damage.
Reaction: a Squad-Mate (not you) fails a save; it succeeds instead with no further effects. Once per creature per initiative.

Casting a jutsu without your Void Soul summoned: it loses Hand Sign and Chakra Molding components; its first attack roll at advantage or the first save against it at disadvantage. In Superego Manifestation: maneuvers inflicting a condition inflict 2 ranks.
